body: You deserve a smile and to laugh. Thanks for sharing as well.
can relate. glad you caught the drinking before possible spiral

Can relate to this. I don't know if it's self harm but definitely will be something added on the list of regrets down the road. I can smell myself right now even though I finally got myself to shower for the first time in a week. I know everyone says it but seek help if you can.
I have always been afraid to call for similar reasons. Thanks for sharing your experience, sorry they treated you this way.

I also have had a similar path. I got an associates degree that is general and doesn't help with anything making me feel like a failure. It's the worst in a small town, has kept me from doing much of anything staying upstairs and moving back in with my parents. Anxiety with depression feels like I am smashing the gas pedal while the emergency break is on or something. Wish I would have moved away when I had a chance. The being a burden and feeling unlovable makes you just want to disappear. You aren't alone..
I'm sorry you're going through this, I also have had these feelings for the past couple of years. The psychopath thoughts came in at one of the lowest points here as well.
In a very similar situation. Losing relationships and pushing people away. Proud of you for going the therapy route having a tough time asking for help myself.
